name: v0.2.3
body:
AnswerLens is a CLI-first AI visibility auditor for product websites.

CI for AI discoverability.

## What ships

- Field-level schema-text consistency and evidence density checks
- Internal link context and discoverability rules for proof pages
- Manual rank import with competitive position score (CPS)
- Repeated-sample stability summaries in `eval-summary.*` and `share-summary.*`
- Publish-ready CLI bundle and tarball plus repo-native report artifacts

## Known limits

- No consumer AI UI scraping
- No ranking guarantees
- Search Console and Bing validation connectors are still planned for `v0.3.0`
- GitHub Pages deployment still depends on repository settings
- npm publish is skipped unless NPM_TOKEN is configured

## Canonical docs

- README: https://github.com/YSCJRH/ai-visibility-auditor#readme
- Distribution plan: https://github.com/YSCJRH/ai-visibility-auditor/blob/main/docs/distribution-plan.md
- Manual steps: https://github.com/YSCJRH/ai-visibility-auditor/blob/main/docs/manual-steps.md
